source: This matters when interpreting profilers. A kernel can execute many global-load instructions while generating much less ZXNAME0000XZ traffic because L1 or L2 supplies repeated requests. The reverse can also happen: poorly coalesced or low-reuse accesses may produce far more downstream traffic than the useful bytes implied by the source code.
zh: 这在解释分析器时很重要。内核可以执行许多全局加载指令，同时生成更少的 ZXNAME0000XZ 流量，因为 L1 或 L2 提供重复的请求。相反的情况也可能发生：合并不佳或重用率低的访问可能会产生比源代码隐含的有用字节多得多的下游流量。
